description: Ministry of Agriculture Land  and Irrigation -Western Province -  Notify Agro Services Authority (Amendment) Statute of Western Province
categorisation: This gazette contains the text of a statute (the Agro Services Authority (Amendment) Statute) that amends an existing provincial law. It details legal amendments to sections of the main statute, including changes to the composition of a management board, the insertion of new subsections outlining the authority's objectives and powers, and modifications to service regulations. The content is primarily focused on legal and regulatory modifications, fitting the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for new laws, acts, amendments, and regulatory matters.
